chunks: But to him who comes to God with a tranquil heart.

key_terms.سَلِيمٍ: Sound, healthy, or free from defects (specifically from shirk)
key_terms.قَلْبٍ: Heart, representing the spiritual center of belief and intention

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to have a 'sound heart' in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'sound heart' (qalb salim) is understood not merely as moral integrity but as a heart purified of all shirk (polytheism) and dominated by tawhid (monotheism), often linked to the concept of 'ismah (infallibility) in the Imams. This verse serves as the culmination of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, contrasting the futile boasting of the poets with the ultimate criterion of divine acceptance: inner spiritual wholeness.
